description: BikePGH's Pittsburgh Bike Map Geographic Data is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by BikePGH. Files include data for bike lanes, protected bike lanes, trails, bike routes, shared lane markings, cautionary bike routes, and bridge data from the BikePGH Pittsburgh Bike Map. BikePGH developed this map in 2007 and has been publishing it both on paper and online ever since. See: for more info. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher BikePGH. Its tags are BikePGH, bicycling, bike lanes, bike routes, bridge. It offers 18 resource(s) in GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
